usedBy: Use this building block in the side column of a desktop payment screen. The action stays outside the card.
overview: A desktop side-column summary with an optional main row, optional details, a required total, an optional notice and a required action.

default.title: With title
default.text: The title is visible by default above the light-up card. Rows and total stay inside the card.

without-title.title: Without title
without-title.text: Pass a title in normal use, such as “Payment summary”. Omitting it is an exception when the surrounding screen already identifies the summary.

with-notice.title: With notice
with-notice.text: The card covers 16px of the notice below it. The action stays outside both.

details-only.title: Details only
details-only.text: Details can be supplied without a main item; the component renders them all in compact density.

api.intro: Transaction Summary is available on Web only and uses separate mainItem, details and total roles.
api.title: Optional title rendered above the card when supplied. In normal use, always pass a title such as “Payment summary”; omitting it is an exception.
api.mainItem: Optional label/value row with default density. It is never inferred from the first detail.
api.details: Optional label/value rows with compact density. Use at most four as a screen-level rule; the component renders all supplied details.
api.total: Required label/value row with bold 16px typography. A divider precedes it whenever a main item or details are present.
api.notice: Optional structured notice. Description is required; title is optional. An omitted icon uses the Ocean positive check icon, while `icon={null}` hides it.
api.action: Required action rendered full width outside the card, with 16px vertical padding.
api.className: Additional class name for the component root.

platforms.ios: Not available; use the mobile Transaction Footer at the bottom of the payment screen.
platforms.android: Not available; use the mobile Transaction Footer at the bottom of the payment screen.

rules: Use Summary in the side column of a desktop payment screen; Footer is the mobile component.
Rows contain only label and value. Use mainItem and details independently; the first detail is not promoted to main.
Use no more than four details as a screen-level rule. Summary renders every detail it receives.
Main and total use default density; details use compact density. Dividers appear after main when details follow and before total whenever rows are above it.
The card is always light-up with 12px corners and covers 16px of the notice below it.
Keep the required action outside the card and notice.
